fields.label: Subject Claim (optional)
fields.description: When set, the report is scoped to this single claim (a payment-decision report) instead of the member's full history. Use the claim's record name or bundle id.

fields.label: Subject Visit (optional)
fields.description: When set, the report is scoped to this visit (all its claims and preauths) instead of the member's full history. Use the consented visit id.

fields.label: Subject Preauth (optional)
fields.description: When set, the report is scoped to this preauthorization (plus its related claims). Use the preauth's record name or bundle id.

fields.label: Narrative Model
fields.description: Which model writes the narrative: auto = stage routing, clinical = clinical model, general = general model, both = run clinical and general and keep both variants.
Comma-separated patient_flow steps fetched for this report, e.g. consent,contributions,claims,preauth.
fields.label: Data Sources

fields.description: The AI mode requested for this run (per-run override; honoured only when HISI Report Settings allows it, else the configured default is used).
fields.label: AI Mode (requested)

fields.description: The AI mode the run actually used (deterministic_only, deterministic_plus_narrative, autonomous_full or legacy_llm).
fields.label: AI Mode Used

fields.description: JSON snapshot of the discrepancy tags declared at generation time: [{tag_code, label, instruction, severity}]. A tag edited or deleted afterwards cannot change the prompt.
fields.label: Tag Snapshot (JSON)

fields.description: The exact prompt text sent to the LLM (system instructions + data context + tag lines + the fixed output contract).
fields.label: Prompt Snapshot

fields.description: The rendered markdown report (success path).
fields.label: Report

fields.description: The normalized findings JSON: {summary, overall, findings: [{tag_code, severity, title, detail, evidence}]}.
fields.label: Findings (JSON)

fields.description: The raw LLM reply (kept for audit).
fields.label: Raw Response

fields.description: The error object JSON on failure: {code, message} — code is one of LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED, LLM_TIMEOUT, LLM_HTTP_ERROR, LLM_PARSE_FAILED, DATA_UNAVAILABLE, WORKER_CRASHED, INTERNAL_ERROR.
fields.label: Error (JSON)

fields.description: The rule catalog version the run executed (HISI Discrepancy Tag rule catalog + evaluator code).
fields.label: Catalog Version

fields.description: Where the benefits knowledge came from for this run: static (the HISI Benefit Intervention matrix) or live (the BenefitsExchange endpoint).
fields.label: Benefits Source

fields.description: Comma-separated list of the LLM models actually called by this run (empty when no LLM was called, e.g. deterministic_only).
fields.label: Models Used

fields.description: SHA-256 of the fetched data context (inputs fingerprint for reproducibility).
fields.label: Data Context Hash

fields.description: The newest data timestamp this run's context saw (max of record creation/service dates) — the 'data as of' marker for staleness checks.
fields.label: Data As Of

fields.description: Per-lane coverage JSON from the rule context (scope + lanes with available/empty/errored status and counts) — rendered in the UI and mirrored in the PDF.
fields.label: Coverage

fields.description: Per-finding provenance JSON: [{tag_code, title, severity, source, catalog_version, verified, evidence_refs}] — includes findings quarantined by evidence verification (audit trail).
fields.label: Findings Provenance (JSON)
